statnnet: statistical selection and interpretation for nnet models

Source: R/statnnet-package.R
statnnet-package.Rd

statnnet selects parsimonious, single-hidden-layer Gaussian regression models fitted with nnet::nnet() and provides regression-style statistical summaries for supported fitted nnet models. Inferential summaries after selection are conditional on the selected model and are not post-selection inference.
